title: Mixed Event — Mermaid Admiration — Episode3 Summer Showtime!

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has begun working as ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland. Their first visit will be to an outdoor stage on a beach. Hearing this, Nene remembers the performance of "The Little Mermaid" that she saw when she was little...

rows.Line: Beach Stage

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line:
That swim really did the trick!
Hm? Why are all those people gathered over there?

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line: Some kind of event, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: We will now be having a special showing of The Adventures of the Merprince and Little Mermaids.

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line: Okay then... Wanna check it out while we take a break? We can just leave if it ends up being boring or something.

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line:
Sure.
Let's go see!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line:
Ah, another beautiful day...
The waves are calm and there's even a nice breeze.

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: As the prince of the merfolk, I could not be happier to see my land in such a harmonious state. However...

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: I'm so bored!!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: There's nothing to do! I wish some treasure would float by or something...!

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line:
Splishy-splishy-splash-splash!
Big bro!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Wah! Wh-What is it, my little sister? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh!
Something interesting just washed up on the shore!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line:
Something interesting...?
Is that so...?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
Ah, another beautiful day...
The waves are calm and there's even a nice breeze.

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: All those humans have to work so hard while us merfolk just get to enjoy ourselves. Who could ask for a better...? Huh?

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Sister!!

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line: Big sis!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
Huh?! W-Wait...!
Didn't I tell you not to barge into my coral reef like that?! I'm busy nap... Getting in some beauty sleep!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Forget that! Just look at this book, will you?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: What the...? The Little Mermaid...?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: This girl goes on land, falls in love with a human and trades her voice to be given a pair of legs... And dissolves into foam?

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line: We read this and decided that we want to try going on land too!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: What? That's what you drew out of this book...?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: All I gathered from this is that no matter how hard we try, humans will never accept us into their world.

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: It even mentions how terrible things happen to merfolk that get caught by the human fishermen...

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line:
But that's just what the story says...
It might actually be really fun up there!

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line: Look! This mermaid got to go to a dance party and eat lots of yummy food!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Yeah! There could be a mountain of fun to be had, and we just don't know it yet!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: B-But... Even if we did go on land, we won't be able to walk like the humans since we don't really have feet...

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Ah, I heard some rumors that one of the merfolk lives far off in the strait and makes these strange potions. Why don't we ask him for some help?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Seriously? There's no way someone living way out there by themselves isn't shady...

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Just play along for one, will you? Otherwise, you'd be locked in here playing video games all day, right?

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line: C'mon, let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
W-Wait..!
Why aren't you listening to me?!

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line:
Haha!
This is pretty good!

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line: Yeah, let's stick around a bit longer!

rows.Speaker: Meroctopus
rows.Line:
Ah, welcome!
It's been decades since anyone's come to visit me!

rows.Speaker: Meroctopus
rows.Line: I hear that you seek a potion that will give you human legs. Here, drink this♪

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line:
*Gulp*... *Gulp*...!
It's not as bad as I imagined.

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line:
Whoa, look!
My tail's glowing!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Huh? This stuff actually works...?!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line:
What the...?!
We've grown legs, but they're covered in scales!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: They're half fish...?

rows.Speaker: Meroctopus
rows.Line: Ah, that didn't quite do it, I see. How about this one...? Wait, this may've been the one for octopus legs...

rows.Speaker: Meroctopus
rows.Line:
Oh, but you can have this.
Drink it when you're in desperate trouble. I would refrain from using it otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Are any of your potions actually safe to use?!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Finally, we made it to a human settlement!

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line:
This is what they call a 'city'?
There's so many big buildings!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Hey, don't forget that we have to keep drinking these potions every hour to keep our legs, so be careful.

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Yes, we know!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Hm? What's this? Is it edible? It's shaped like a fish, but has some kind of black substance inside...

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line:
Nom... It's so yummy☆
It's so warm and sweet! I've never had anything like this before!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Have you two forgotten that it's not safe out here...?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: But they seem to be enjoying themselves, so maybe it was worth the trip...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
Oh, these games look fun too.
I didn't even know the humans have this many games in their city...

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid's Voice
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Merprince's Voice
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
Huh?
They got caught?! How...?!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Oh no...! Don't tell me they forgot to drink their potions and lost their legs...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: The humans that took them away looked really scary too...! What do I do?! Even if I did try to rescue them, I'll just end up getting caught too...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Wait, I know!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: I still have that weird potion! The one for when we get into really big trouble...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: This is terrifying... But I have to save them before something awful happens to them!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Wait... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Wh-What just happened to me?!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: No, I don't have time for that right now... I have to figure out a way to save them...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Okay!! Let's go!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa! Where'd this gust come from?! Was it that giant fan over there?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Look! It's like Mech Mermaid's really flying!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Hang on, you guys...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to see our show today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll be eagerly awaiting your arrival at Phoenix Wonderland, so please make sure to come and visit sometime!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-Night tickets are also available!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our nighttime spectacles are full of wonderful illuminations, so please don't miss out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Come have some with us at Phoenix Wonderland, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line: That park does shows like this? That's pretty cool.

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line: I used to go there all the time when I was a kid, but it might be nice to go now since it's been a while.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
Our show actually made them want to visit Phoenix Wonderland...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like our first performance was a big success.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad we decided to shorten the show and add in some effects that involve air and water.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So am I! Let's keep this up and knock our afternoon performance out of the park!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Rui & Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!
Beach

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Phew...
All that's left for today is to clean everything up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Robo-Nene needs to be recharged when I get back to the hotel too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm so glad our first day as ambassadors went so well...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Our story ended up being much happier compared to the Little Mermaid I saw when I was little...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But our version seemed to make everybody smile, so I can't really ask for more.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, I should get back to the stage and... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Such a beautiful voice...
My heart's starting to race for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait...
No, it can't be...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No way...!!
Hehe. The beach really never disappoints. I feel like I can sing forever here!
It'd be nice to go for a swim, but I forgot to bring a bathing suit. Maybe I can dry my clothes on the sand since it's so warm out...

Hm...?
Oh, hello there. Can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Are you...?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Diving into an unknown world is terrifying, but not being able to because of my own fears would be much worse!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: 'I'm going! I need to see him...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yuka Kazamatsuri...?!
